info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Banking It Management Technology Standard By Technology Standard Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access detailed information about a specific Banking IT Management Technology Standard using its unique identifier. It serves as a valuable resource for developers and IT personnel looking to understand compliance and standards within the banking sector. Typical consumers of this API include banking institutions and technology consultants who require standardized information for regulatory compliance or operational purposes. The endpoint streamlines the retrieval process, facilitating better integration of technology standards into various banking applications.

get.summary: Retrieve technology standard details by ID.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch detailed information about a specific technology standard identified by its unique ID. It provides insights into compliance, specifications, and best practices related to the technology standard.
